notes: New: Every guest form is now kept on the booking exactly as the guest answered it, with the form's sections in order.
New: If you send a guest more than one form, each one is shown separately on the booking.
Improved: Lists, such as children or vehicles, show as neat tables on the booking.
Improved: Signatures from guest forms show as a picture with the signer's name.
Improved: Questions the guest left blank now say "No answer".
Improved: Export now includes every guest form as answered, with the date it was completed.
Fixed: Older bookings with saved form answers still show them.
Fixed: A signature on a form is now kept even if it isn't the main contract signature.
